schema_descriptions.1: Excellent - From or directly applicable to the modelled time.
schema_descriptions.2: Good - From a different but similar time or only slightly out of date. Still highly relevant.
schema_descriptions.3: Acceptable - From a somewhat similar time or several years out of date but still relevant.
schema_descriptions.4: Lacking - From a time with different conditions or significantly out of date. Questionable relevance.
schema_descriptions.5: Unacceptable - From an irrelevant time or badly out of date.

temporal_review.reference_time: Modelled time according to schema; not current system year, release timestamp or native dollar year.
temporal_review.minimal_supported_static_approach: Explicit source/component temporal annotations with evidence-year rationale; keep existing DQ component > source > registry fallback resolution and reviewed overrides.
dynamic_row_scoring_requires_user_policy: Numeric year bands for slight/several/significant/irrelevant age, if automated distance scoring is desired.
Reference: row vintage, period endpoint, source observation interval, scenario base_year, or applicability interval.

Treatment of evergreen physical properties, repeated fixed assumptions and multiple evidence years.

mixed_year_context_evidence.finding: rating_inputs selects bracketing native years then returns only source/component identifiers, so components span multiple actual observation years.

Rows group by mode, region, range_aggregated and contributors; vintage/year is not in the context grouping. Same rating-source context covers historical and future target vintages when contributor tuples match.

Final composite DQ is governed by first designated input, generally CEUD, not worst/latest/mean NRCan rating time; adding row-age scoring would need explicit intent and is not just filling null source annotations.
One context covers latest provincial observations from2016-2020 and Canada2020 fallback; exact source years remain in row notes/audit.
